_finding: Owner, 25.11: the fake exchange is built from aggregates of our impostor list. An unread pool must never pass for an empty one, the weekly award may only go up within its week, and the deployer the list holds is never copied out. Money gathered is only the WETH or stablecoin side of a fake's pools: DexScreener's liquidity figure prices the fake's own side by the fake.

mutations.name: an unread pool is not counted apart
mutations.expect: FAIL an unread pool is counted apart, never as zero

mutations.name: a failed batch is taken as empty
mutations.expect: FAIL a batch that failed is unread, not empty

mutations.name: a later, poorer fake takes the week
mutations.expect: FAIL a poorer fake later in the week does not take the title

mutations.name: the deployer is copied
mutations.replace: kind: it.kind, first_seen_at: it.first_seen_at || null, deployer: it.deployer }
mutations.expect: FAIL the deployer is never copied

mutations.name: a fake symbol is shown with its link
mutations.expect: FAIL a fake's symbol is the deployer's text

mutations.name: both sides of the pool are counted as money
mutations.find: e.usd += realSideUsd(p, a, reference); e.reported += reported
mutations.expect: FAIL the same pool twice in an answer counts once

mutations.name: any counterpart counts, not only a reference asset
mutations.expect: FAIL a pool against anything but a reference asset is zero
